assessmentQuestionVersion.name: SWS_RiskAssessment_Q6
assessmentQuestionVersion.responseValues: No treatment or inadequate treatment in place/Insufficient chemical monitoring history: No treatment, or inadequate treatment to address known or suspected chemical parameters, is currently in place, or limited or insufficient chemical monitoring data is available. MAC exceeded in treated water: Maximum Acceptable Concentration exceeded for one or more chemical parameters (in treated water). Chemical contamination identified — Adequate treatment in place: Chemical parameters elevated in source water but adequate treatment in place that reduces values below MAC in treated water. Source water meets water quality guidelines: System consistently meets all chemical water quality guidelines with no exceedances identified.
